name: SiteHeader
summary: A floating glass bar at the top of every page with the site's name and the main navigation.

guidance.useFor: The top of every page of a site: the wordmark linking home and up to six links to its main sections, the current one marked.
insteadUse: Showing where a page sits in a hierarchy: Breadcrumb
Navigating within one page: Table of contents
Actions on the page (sign in, search): buttons or Search, after the navigation
content: Name sections with one word where you can: Work, Journal, About, Contact
Keep the list short enough to fit two lines on a phone

rungReason: <header> is the banner landmark and <nav> the navigation; links with aria-current mark the page. No script.

attributes.aria-current: page, on the page being shown

a11y.role: banner (header at the top of the body), with a navigation landmark
a11y.name: The navigation: its aria-label ("Main")

keyboard.action: Reaches the wordmark, then each link

rules: Put a skip link before it
Sticky only on viewports at least 30rem tall, so at high zoom it can't cover the page or what has focus (WCAG 1.4.10, 2.4.11); where it sticks, set scroll-padding-block-start on the page
The list wraps on narrow screens rather than hiding behind a menu button (ADR-0011)
The current page is marked in words for assistive technology (aria-current) and by more than colour on screen
contrast: An opaque surface (--lue-color-bg-surface) under increased contrast, reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter
forcedColors: The bar: Canvas with a CanvasText border; the current link is underlined
